findings.claim: Himax 2023 全年毛利率 27.9%，前一年 40.5%；2023 Q2 單季毛利率 21.7%（Q1 28.1%），Q4 回升至 30.3%（來源為搜尋摘要轉述，未讀原頁）
findings.source: Himax Q4 2023 earnings call / press release (alphaspread, SEC 6-K exh_991)

findings.claim: SOX 2022 年自年初高點跌約 36%（盤中最深約 42–44%），高點約 2022 年 1 月初、谷底約 2022 年 10 月，約 9 個月
findings.source: 247wallst, Chip Stocks Are Bleeding Today. The 2018 and 2022 Selloffs

findings.claim: TechInsights（Hutcheson）：1963 年來 14 次半導體下行，平均每 4.4 年一次；半導體平均衰退約 -8%、設備約 -20%；WSTS 資料平均週期 52 個月（37–82 個月）
findings.source: TechInsights, The Chip Insider – Cyclical History of the Semiconductor Industry; ECIA Semiconductor Cycle Outlook 2019

findings.excerpt: Gross margin in 2023 was 27.9%, decreasing from 40.5% in 2022. As a reminder, in Q2, the Company strategically terminated high-cost foundry capacity agreements, leading to a depressed Q2 gross margin of just 21.7%.
